subject: Engagement stack lifecycle decision matrix
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, SalesLoft Sales Ops <salesops@salesloft.com>, Outreach Procurement <procure@outreach.io>
Cc: Amanda Price <amanda.price@acme.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Engagement stack lifecycle decision matrix

Team — attaching the decision matrix I mentioned in the ops sync. High level: Acme Analytics is evaluating whether to renew Outreach for their outbound SDR team or migrate to SalesLoft. They asked Redwood for a recommendation because our integrations and telemetry are core to their reporting.

Attachments: decision-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), Outreach-quote-v3.pdf (vendor quote stub)

Quick context:
- Customer: Acme Analytics (enterprise, 450 sales seats)
- Current: Outreach (renewal due 2028-06-30)
- Consideration: total cost of ownership + implementation risk + integration coverage (SFDC + Redwood usage tracking)

Ask: please review the decision matrix and the Outreach quote and reply with:
- One-line recommendation (Renew Outreach | Migrate to SalesLoft | Hybrid)
- Top 2 risks we need procurement/legal to validate
- If recommend migration, high-level ETA and rough migration cost (not vendor quote; our internal estimate)

I'll pull together a short recommendation for the exec sponsor after we align. Can we aim to close internal alignment by Friday 2028-05-13 EOD?

Thanks —
Mina
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-05-11T11:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement stack lifecycle decision matrix

Hi Mina —

Thanks for looping us in and for the matrix. A couple of quick clarifying Qs so our team can plug accurate numbers into your spreadsheet: 
- For reporting latency tolerances you list "near-real-time" — do you have an SLA target in tokens/sec or API latency?
- Implementation scope: are you counting SFDC <> SalesLoft managed mappings only, or also custom objects and the Adobe connector Acme mentioned?

We can get a tailored quote by EOD tomorrow once we know the expected SLAs and whether custom objects are in scope. In the meantime I attached our standard onboarding checklist (stub).

Regards,
Evan Blake
Sales Operations, SalesLoft
salesops@salesloft.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: SalesLoft Sales Ops <salesops@salesloft.com>, Outreach Procurement <procure@outreach.io>, Amanda Price <amanda.price@acme.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement stack lifecycle decision matrix

Thanks — skimmed the matrix this morning and added inline notes (see tab: "revops-notes"). High-level thoughts: 

- Recommendation: Hybrid approach (renew Outreach for 3 months while piloting SalesLoft for 50 seats). Reason: lowers immediate business disruption and gives us objective signal on platform telemetry parity.

- Top 2 technical risks: 
  1) Event fidelity: Outreach currently pushes activity payloads that our Redwood ingestion job expects; we need confirmation SalesLoft can deliver the same webhook schema or we’ll need ~2 weeks of engineering effort for mapping.
  2) Historical data continuity: Exporting sequence state and engagement history from Outreach to SalesLoft is non-trivial for >1 year retention — we should budget for data migration scripts and a reconciliation pass.

- Rough migration cost (internal estimate): 
  - Engineering + RevOps: 3–4 FTE-weeks (~$60k) for mapping, transforms, and validation
  - CS/Onboarding: vendor professional services (variable) — expect $25–40k if SalesLoft recommends a managed package

Procurement watchlist: contract termination clauses / pro-rata refunds, and the SSO/KM integration timing.

I also asked Amanda (Acme) in a separate thread about which Salesforce custom objects are critical. Her note: "we have 4 custom objects that drive scoring."

Marissa
Senior Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: SalesLoft Sales Ops <salesops@salesloft.com>, Outreach Procurement <procure@outreach.io>
Date: 2028-05-12T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement stack lifecycle decision matrix

Quick procurement/legal checklist from my side — flagged items we need to land before any PO/commitment: 

1) Data export & retention: ensure Outreach will provide a full export of sequences/comments/analytics in a machine-readable format within 14 days of contract termination. Add this as a contractual SL.
2) IP & derivative usage: verify whether vendor retains anonymized engagement telemetry rights (we prefer to retain all derived telemetry for customer-facing analytics).
3) SLA credits & termination pro-ration: confirm pro-rata for unused months vs. credit only.
4) Security: confirm SOC 2 Type II evidence that includes change-management logs for webhook endpoints.

If we go hybrid (Marissa's proposal) procurement path: 
- Short-term: sign a 3-month extension with Outreach (pause auto-renew) — include export SL and data escrow clause.
- Pilot contract with SalesLoft for 50 seats on a month-to-month pilot with limited data access until migration scripts pass QA.

I'll draft the two contract addenda and circulate a DocuSign link for Mina's review. Timeline: I can get drafts out by 2028-05-14 if we confirm approach today.

Rishi
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Procurement
Redwood Inference
Attachment: procurement-checklist.docx (stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: SalesLoft Sales Ops <salesops@salesloft.com>, Outreach Procurement <procure@outreach.io>, Amanda Price <amanda.price@acme.com>
Date: 2028-05-13T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement stack lifecycle decision matrix

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. Plan that I’ll present to the exec sponsor tomorrow morning: 

1) Internal recommendation: Hybrid (3-month Outreach extension + 50-seat SalesLoft pilot). Rationale: minimizes go/no-go risk and buys time for accurate telemetry comparisons.
2) Action owners and due dates: 
  - Rishi: draft Outreach 3-month addendum + data export clause (first cut by 2028-05-14)
  - Marissa: finalize migration estimate and build pilot acceptance criteria (2028-05-15)
  - Aditya: scope potential infra work on Redwood ingestion side for SalesLoft webhooks (POC by 2028-05-20)
  - SalesLoft / Outreach: please send final commercial terms for pilot/extenstion by EOD 2028-05-14 (outreach: Outreach-quote-v3.pdf attached previously)

I'll book a 30-minute alignment call for 2028-05-14 10:00 AM PT. If any vendor can't meet that turnaround, flag here.

Mina
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
